blockers.finding: Baseline charges bitmap plus event execution only, while candidate additionally charges one scratch write and two read/commit passes. The two arms do not define and symmetrically charge the common two-vector output/psum sink path.
blockers.impact: Candidate-only 387 scratch cycles dominate the smallest interior full-overlap boundary case, yielding 146/462=0.316017x. This can be a conservative schedule bound but cannot support an irreversible permanent kill.

blockers.finding: The no-free-resource gate checks two byte constants and a user-authored true boolean; it is not derived from a capacity/port/transaction ledger.
blockers.impact: The model does not prove that pair buffers, comparator, overlap accumulation state, output psum banks and the 16.03125-KiB scratch coexist inside the same 240-KiB organization or preserve its reload behavior.

blockers.finding: scratch_port_conflict_cycles is initialized to zero and never incremented; queue occupancy and weight/output bank conflicts are absent. Aggregate 128 B/cycle is substituted for the required real mapping.
blockers.impact: The analyzer does not implement the independently authorized queue/backpressure/bank-conflict evidence.

blockers.finding: A one-cycle synchronous read response is declared, but each serialized read pass is charged only N request cycles and omits its final response/commit tail.
blockers.impact: Interior scratch service is at least 389 rather than 387 cycles; top-edge service is at least 260 rather than 258 cycles.

blockers.finding: Only validation aggregate event integers are compared with M501. Train overall/per-sequence, exact payload codeword, module geometry and sample-by-operator Cartesian completeness are not directly checked.
blockers.impact: The stated fail-closed M501-ledger and cohort-completeness guarantees are weaker than the contract.

required_before_go: Freeze a named baseline storage/output-sink organization and derive same-resource status from a complete capacity/port ledger rather than a boolean.
Symmetrically charge both arms for the two destination vectors and isolate only compare/save/seed incremental cost in the candidate.
Model synchronous read response tails and report serialized scratch stalls honestly.
Implement weight/output-bank mapping and queue/backpressure accounting, or narrow the contract and decision so the result is not called same-resource.
Reconcile validation and train M501 ledgers and add exact-codeword, geometry and Cartesian-completeness checks.
Lock new analyzer/contract SHA identities and obtain a new independent preflight GO before consuming the one-shot run.
